[LSIG.5.2] `SeriesBackendIntervalPulse` has a single exact form and is available under `realtime`
and `linear_scan: false` with no approximate substitute: its state is bounded by the
declared capacity and its query is O(K)-bounded for WCET. A boolean slot
whose worst-case transition count would overflow a practical capacity is
almost always un-debounced chatter and must be debounced at the adapter.
